result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position by permitting transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction; affiliates are already covered without the fallback’s written-notice condition. It also advances the preferred position by covering contractors acting on Sparkling’s behalf. The edits are limited and preserve the Authorized Location, AS400, fee, and exclusivity restrictions. It does not address perpetual/irrevocable paid-up rights or subscription termination, but the original clause does not identify the licence as paid-up or subscription-based. Drafting is generally professional, though the placement of “in each case at Authorized Locations” is slightly awkward.
